constitution.history: previous 1912, 1931; latest adopted 25 December 1946, promulgated 1 January 1947, effective 25 December 1947
constitution.amend: proposed by at least one fourth of the Legislative Yuan membership; passage requires approval by at least three-fourths majority vote of at least three fourths of the Legislative Yuan membership and approval in a referendum by more than half of eligible voters

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of the court president, vice president, and approximately 100 judges organized into civil and criminal panels, each with a chief justice and 4 associate justices); Constitutional Court (consists of the court president, vice president, and 13 justices)
courts.judges: Supreme Court justices appointed for life by the president; Constitutional Court justices appointed by the president, with approval of the Legislative Yuan, for 8-year terms, with half the membership renewed every 4 years
courts.lower: high courts; district courts; hierarchy of administrative courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Taiwan
citizenship.dual: yes, except that citizens of Taiwan are not recognized as dual citizens of the People's Republic of China

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
